result.title: SmolVLA-MoE: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts for Efficient Multi-Task Robotic Manipulation
result.comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables; conference paper prepared for IROS2027
result.summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promising results in multi-task robotic manipulation by leveraging visual and language understanding for action generation. However, existing lightweight VLA models employ a single dense action expert to handle all tasks, which limits their multi-task capability under constrained computational budgets. To address this issue, we propose SmolVLA-MoE, a novel framework that introduces sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) into the FFN layers of the action expert in VLA models. SmolVLA-MoE replaces dense FFN layers with multiple parallel expert FFNs and a token-level router, enabling each token to adaptively select the most suitable expert for action generation. We further introduce a shared expert with a tunable weight parameter to balance the inheritance of pre-trained capabilities and task-specific expert specialization. Through sparse activation, SmolVLA-MoE activates only a single expert FFN during inference, with a total activated parameter count of approximately 500M including the frozen VLM backbone, while benefiting from approximately 800M total stored parameters. We evaluate our method on four task suites of the LIBERO benchmark. SmolVLA-MoE achieves an average success rate of 84.25%, outperforming SmolVLA (82.75%) and OpenVLA-7B (76.5%), while maintaining comparable inference efficiency. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/dudu435/smolvla-moe.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作在轻量 VLA 模型的 action expert FFN 中引入稀疏 Mixture-of-Experts 与 token 级路由器，使每个 token 自适应选择单个专家，并加入带可调权重的共享专家以兼顾预训练能力与任务专精，在 LIBERO 四个任务套件上评测。
AI.relevance_reason: token 级稀疏路由与共享专家权重控制，可能为 LVR 中按需分配计算、以及专家化的状态更新与能力保留提供可核查线索；但论文面向机器人动作生成，未涉及 latent 推理状态或视觉证据筛选。
